english.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for supporting facts, including scientific and general court evidence.
This is the all-purpose choice for evidence that establishes or supports a fact.
This is the all-purpose choice for evidence or proof of a fact.
Use this as the all-purpose noun for facts or arguments that clear someone or support a claim.
Use this when the support consists of evidence for a claim or theory.
Use this for a thing that serves as evidence or a sign, not for a person or their spoken testimony.
Use this when facts are being treated as concrete evidence supporting a conclusion.
